The private markets have changed.

Venture capital firms, sovereign wealth funds...
items.raw_snippet:
The private markets have changed.

Venture capital firms, sovereign wealth funds and other institutional investors can now provide enormous amounts of funding to companies that might once have needed an IPO to finance their expansion.

That allows businesses to remain private longer, even as their valuations climb into the hundreds of billions or trillions of dollars. [...] Today, some technology companies are reaching valuations many times larger while they’re still privately held.

And AI is a major reason why.

OpenAI helped ignite the generative AI boom with ChatGPT. Anthropic has emerged as one of its strongest competitors, particularly in AI coding and enterprise applications.

Both companies are attracting enormous investment because their backers believe AI could become as essential to the economy as electricity or the internet. [...] Meanwhile, SpaceX has built a dominant rocket-launching business and a global satellite network through Starlink. And its acquisition of xAI has brought Musk’s Grok technology into the same company.

In other words, investors aren’t simply betting on three successful technology companies. They’re betting that these businesses could become some of the most important players in the AI economy.

And there’s another reason their valuations have grown so large before reaching public investors.
